result:
Final report written to `homework-4.2/FINAL_REPORT.md`. Summary of the synthesis:

- **One real functional gap** (MEDIUM): `ArticleApi.updateArticle` has no `@Valid`/annotations at all, so it silently accepts empty or unbounded article updates.
- **A recurring LOW-severity pattern**: missing `@Size` upper bounds on user-supplied strings, showing up across login/registration, profile update, article creation, query params, and path variables — treated as one repo-wide hardening item rather than six separate bugs.
- **Nothing high-risk**: no SQL injection, no missing auth checks, no misapplied DTO-vs-path-variable convention; `TagsApi` and `CurrentUserReportsApi` have no external input surface at all.
- I also closed the one open item from TASK-1 (whether `RegisterParam`'s own fields validate) by reading it directly — confirmed it has required-field checks but the same missing-`@Size` gap as everything else.
